description: Books a class or appointment on the trainer's schedule (Brazil time, America/Sao_Paulo), with a student or as a personal block when student_id is empty. The student is notified, like in the app. To move or cancel it later use reschedule_class or cancel_class.

student_id.description: student_id from list_students; empty for a personal block.
